# Ledger delta: an application on SQLite (infra-agnostic slices 8b, 8c, 9 and risk fix 7)

Slice 8b (2026-11-04) adds the accepted risk `development_database_in_prod`,
which admits a development-only database (SQLite) in production
(SANDLOOM-B029; the strict profile refuses it even when accepted), and a
guarantee for the refusal.

| Id | Disposition |
| --- | --- |
| G-RISK-03 | Retain: every registered risk is documented and pinned. The statement lists the thirteen current ids, `development_database_in_prod` among them; the pinning test is unchanged apart from the new id. |
| G-RISK-13 | New: a production process on a development-only database is refused unless `development_database_in_prod` is accepted, and the strict profile refuses it even then; enforced by `test_sqlite_boot.py`. |
| G-UOW-09 | New (slice 8c, approved by the owner 2026-11-05): on a serial-writer database a nested write unit of the same task runs as a SAVEPOINT of its caller and commits with it; its post-commit effects wait for the caller's COMMIT; labelled "commits with the caller"; PostgreSQL unchanged; enforced by `test_sqlite_nested_units.py`. |
| G-UOW-09 | Retain, restated (risk fix 7, approved by the owner 2026-11-05): a unit nests only inside a caller that has already run a statement; a unit opened inside a unit that has run no statement yet, including inside an early `begin_nested()`, commits on its own. The rest of the statement unchanged; `test_a_unit_before_the_outer_wrote_commits_on_its_own` and the nesting oracle (`test_nested_units_match_the_oracle`) added to its tests. |
| G-CMD-01 | Retain, restated (risk fix 7, approved by the owner 2026-11-05): the dedupe record is claimed in the same transaction as the command's effect and commits iff it commits: the provider's own unit of work, or on a serial-writer database (G-UOW-09) the caller's transaction it joins; a retry after a crash following that COMMIT replays and never re-executes. Both enforcing tests kept; the saga crash-point law and `test_an_outer_rollback_undoes_the_inner_unit` added. |
| G-SAGA-07 | Retain, restated (risk fix 7, approved by the owner 2026-11-05; restated again after its review, approved 2026-11-05): a crash before the step call or after the step's effect committed converges without re-applying the step; where the provider commits on its own (PostgreSQL; on every database, a provider over RPC or on another database instance) the step's started marker commits before the call and a redrive replays the same key from the command log; on a serial-writer database a provider on the same database instance commits its effect, its dedupe record and the step's state in one transaction (all lost or all kept). `test_crash_after_the_provider_committed_replays_the_same_key` became the crash-point law `test_a_crash_at_any_point_of_a_step_converges_without_reapplying_it` (before the call, after the effect, after the commit; its PostgreSQL branch keeps every assertion of the old test); `test_nondeterministic_args_after_a_crash_never_apply_the_step_twice` and `test_a_deadline_after_a_crash_resolves_a_provider_elsewhere_first` added. |
| G-SAGA-11 | Retain, statement unchanged (risk fix 7): `test_a_deadline_after_a_crash_resolves_a_provider_elsewhere_first` added (a provider on another instance, both databases: the marker committed before the call survives the crash, the deadline resolves before compensating). |
| G-SAGA-04 | Retain, statement unchanged (risk fix 7): `test_nondeterministic_args_hit_the_command_log_conflict_and_park` is replaced by `test_nondeterministic_args_on_a_reissued_key_conflict_and_park`, which asserts the conflict and park on both databases (a timeout after the provider ran: the key is recorded with the attempt). Its crash form, `test_nondeterministic_args_after_a_crash_never_apply_the_step_twice`, is listed under G-SAGA-07. |
| G-SAGA-12 | Retain, statement unchanged (risk fix 7): `test_a_crash_after_the_provider_committed_is_never_reissued_after_the_ttl` became `test_a_crash_after_the_effect_is_never_reissued_after_the_ttl` (PostgreSQL: parks `outcome_unknown_after_ttl`, as before; SQLite: the crash lost the effect and the marker, the deadline compensates, the step is never re-issued).; `test_a_provider_elsewhere_is_never_reissued_after_the_ttl` added (a provider on another instance, both databases: parks `outcome_unknown_after_ttl`). |
| G-INFRA-09 | New (slice 9, approved by the owner 2026-11-05): a module using a database feature form declares the feature (C030); load refuses an instance lacking it (B033); a statement compiled without it refuses naming it (R015); enforced by `test_database_feature_forms.py`. |

No guarantee, enforcing assertion, or residual-risk requirement is removed.
